title: Fastest Supercomputers: TOP500 November 2026
desc: The ten highest-ranked systems in the November 2026 TOP500 list by measured High Performance Linpack (HPL) performance. TOP500 ranks systems that were submitted and accepted for the edition.

source.name: TOP500 — November 2026 list
source.note: On 23 November 2026 (Korea time), the AllRanks assistant (Codex) checked all ten system names, countries, ranks and Rmax values against the official November 2026 TOP500 table. Rmax is measured High Performance Linpack performance in PFlop/s. The snapshot covers places 1–10 of the 500 listed systems. Inclusion depends on submission and acceptance by TOP500.
